mechanism.claim: During elevated BTC path variation, relative strength in a fixed speculative alt basket (DOGE, ADA, XRP) versus a fixed core smart-contract/exchange basket (ETH, BNB, SOL) measures migration toward or away from high-beta crypto risk. A new upper-tail absolute rotation should relay into BTC for eight hours: follow speculative leadership and short speculative retreat.
mechanism.side: strict sign of median speculative-basket eight-hour return minus median core-basket eight-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: Cross-alt breadth counts signs, return dispersion measures an unsigned spread, tail asymmetry measures distribution shape, market-mode candidates use common correlation, and alt-basket leadership estimates minute lead-lag against BTC. HVSARR uses a predeclared semantic two-tier relative-return spread; it uses no BTC return direction, flow, volume, funding, OI, premium, fitted outcome, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, targeting July-like unstable markets
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: new onsets of an offset three-daily semantic cross-alt rotation tail are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: exact 480 one-minute rows [D-8h,D) for every alt
features.symbol_return: log(last minute close / first minute open), strict finite nonzero
features.basket_return: cross-sectional median of the three fixed symbol returns
features.rotation: speculative basket return minus core basket return, strict nonzero
features.rotation_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute rotation against at most 270 prior source-valid decisions; minimum 180; current excluded; rank at least 0.70
features.btc_variation: sum squared log(close/open) over exact 1440 BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-24h,D)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 270 prior source-valid decisions; minimum 180; current excluded; rank at least 0.65
features.trigger: false-to-true onset of both ranks against the previous source-valid decision
features.invalid: missing, duplicate, nonpositive, inconsistent OHLC, zero symbol return, zero rotation, or incomplete exact grid; no imputation

clock.decision: exact 01:00, 09:00, and 17:00 UTC after the completed eight-hour block
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes after decision
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent fixed semantic two-tier crypto risk-rotation mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, train/test/eval/final strict economics, then RV20 q90 audit; no basket, symbol, block, median, rotation, history, rank, variation, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, source, or control repair
